biotools.summary: IGUA is a scalable and flexible method for gene cluster family delineation, particularly suited for analyzing genomic segments with multi-gene architectures. It offers a substantial speed advantage over existing tools while maintaining accuracy and enabling the clustering of diverse gene clusters.
